title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Watermelon Breeze 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Watermelon Breeze conjures the refreshing taste of delicately sweet, sun-ripened Watermelon, enhanced with a cool icy finish. This meticulously crafted e-liquid offers a fresh, fruity inhale followed by a smooth and frosty exhale, making it a great choice for those who enjoy a chilled fruit vape. Crafted for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid provides a satisfying and smooth throat hit while ensuring efficient nicotine absorption. With a 50/50 VG/PG ratio, it delivers excellent flavour clarity and discreet vapour production, making it ideal for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids offer a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, allowing you to enjoy familiar flavours in a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a secure childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
